description: This file contains implementation functions related to emitting diff records, managing hunks, and various utilities for processing diffs within the LibXDiff library, specifically focusing on the emission of diff output, context handling, and function name detection.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_record(xdfile_t * xdf,long ri,char const * pre,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emits a diff record for a specific file record, passing the formatted output via callback.

methods.name: long saturating_add(long a,long b)
methods.description: Performs addition with saturation at LONG_MAX to prevent overflow.

methods.name: xdchange_t * xdl_get_hunk(xdchange_t ** xscr,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg)
methods.description: Determines the range of changes to include in a diff hunk based on configuration and change proximity.

methods.name: long def_ff(const char * rec,long len,char * buf,long sz)
methods.description: Default function to extract identifiers from a record buffer if no custom find function is provided.

methods.name: long match_func_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,long ri,char * buf,long sz)
methods.description: Finds a function-recognizing pattern in a record using either a custom or default method.

methods.name: int is_func_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,long ri)
methods.description: Checks if a given record corresponds to a function definition.

methods.name: long get_func_line(xdfenv_t * xe,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,struct func_line * func_line,long start,long limit)
methods.description: Retrieves a line that likely contains a function name, scanning from start to limit.

methods.name: int is_empty_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,long ri)
methods.description: Checks if a record is empty or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_diff(xdfenv_t * xe,xdchange_t * xscr,xdemitcb_t * ecb,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg)
methods.description: Main function to emit a diff of two files based on a set of change ranges, with context, function names, and hunks.

ctags.pattern: /^static long def_ff(const char *rec, long len, char *buf, long sz)$/

ctags.signature: (xdfenv_t * xe,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,struct func_line * func_line,long start,long limit)

ctags.pattern: /^static int is_func_rec(xdfile_t *xdf, xdemitconf_t const *xecfg, long ri)$/

ctags.signature: (xdfile_t * xdf,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,long ri,char * buf,long sz)
